title: Boundary criticality in the Gross-Neveu-Yukawa model at higher orders
summary: We extend the study of boundary criticality in the Gross-Neveu-Yukawa universality class beyond leading order. Using the hyperbolic space formulation of boundary conformal field theories, we compute the first subleading corrections at large $N$ to the free energies of the ``normal", ``ordinary" and ``special" boundary universality classes. We also determine the order $1/N$ correction to the dimension of the boundary fermion at the normal fixed point.
